name: obs_auth_service_failure_count
description: Auth identity, phone finalization and vault bootstrap server errors; expected invalid codes and ownership conflicts excluded. No extracted labels.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="__BACKEND_SERVICE__" AND ((textPayload=~"\"message\":\"request[.]summary\"" AND textPayload=~"\"route_template\":\"(/api/account/identity/refresh|/api/account/phone/(claim|uat-test/(start|confirm)|transfer/(prepare|confirm|\\{transfer_id\\}))|/db/vault/bootstrap-state)\"" AND textPayload=~"\"outcome_class\":\"server_error\"") OR (jsonPayload.message="request.summary" AND jsonPayload.route_template=~"^(/api/account/identity/refresh|/api/account/phone/(claim|uat-test/(start|confirm)|transfer/(prepare|confirm|\\{transfer_id\\}))|/db/vault/bootstrap-state)$" AND jsonPayload.outcome_class="server_error")) OR (resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="__BACKEND_SERVICE__" AND (textPayload=~"phone[.]transfer[.](proof_provider_unavailable|provider_preflight_unavailable|unlink_pending|reconciliation_pending|recovery_unavailable|notification_pending)" OR jsonPayload.message=~"^phone[.]transfer[.](proof_provider_unavailable|provider_preflight_unavailable|unlink_pending|reconciliation_pending|recovery_unavailable|notification_pending)$"))
